Highlights / callouts for the customer packet:
- We advertise primary routes from our eu-west-1 peering subnets; standby peering will use a different ASN pair and a distinct BGP community so HelixPay can identify and prefer the primary during normal ops. Failover is handled by BGP withdraw + controlled community flip; expected convergence for new sessions is ~30-45s for TCP flows, token cache warmup ~90-120s for large embeddings workloads.
- Private peering options depend on their cloud provider. For GCP/Azure we recommend Private Service Connect/Private Link equivalents; for on-prem we support Direct Connect/express routes to our co-lo POPs.
- Limitations: cross-region replication does not occur by default — backups are stored in the region designated by the tenancy and only copied to other regions with explicit customer opt-in for archival DR.
